Our mission

Long-term, effective asset management

Our mission is to create and maintain wealth for our clients through long-term, effective asset management. We build client relationships based on trust, competent professional advice, continual communication and prompt personal service.

We assist clients in setting financial goals, monitoring those goals and keeping them informed of the process and pursuit of those goals.

Who we are

A team approach for a complex financial world

No one strategy fits everyone. That’s why every client gets our undivided attention, from planning to execution to follow-up.

Our philosophy

Several perspectives, one focus: you

Over the years, we have found that a team approach can be an effective way to help clients who have a wide variety of needs as they maneuver through a complex financial-services world. We believe there are far-reaching benefits to getting opinions from several sources with diverse backgrounds, education and experience.

We take a proactive approach to helping you develop a strategy for your financial goals and objectives, using the most efficient methods available. Everyone encounters challenges along the way, so we strive to anticipate and address them as they occur, to keep you on track toward a meaningful and purpose-driven financial future.

Our process

From planning to execution to follow-up

At our firm, we have the client, and only the client, in mind.

01UnderstandWe learn your goals, your risk tolerance and your time horizon.
02PlanWe develop a strategy that carefully balances investment strategies with preserving principal.
03Put it in placeWe carry out the strategy using the most efficient methods available.
04Follow upWe monitor your goals and keep you informed of the process and the pursuit of those goals.
Education

Knowledge is power

It’s also the foundation for intelligent, well-considered decisions. When you have retirement in sight, sound decisions are vital in helping you pursue your goals and avoid costly mistakes. From investments to retirement to insurance, the decisions can be overwhelming.

Our reasons for becoming financial professionals are deeply personal: we saw friends and family struggle to find the help they needed. Over the years we have built a reputation for educating individuals in an easy-to-understand manner, so they can grasp personal finance and use those concepts to pursue their financial objectives.

Our values

Trust. Honesty. Integrity.

We believe values matter, and we live by ours every day. We feel a commitment to our community and to the clients we serve.

On this page
01

Financial Planning

Setting goals, monitoring them, and keeping you informed.

We assist clients in setting financial goals, monitoring those goals and keeping them informed of the process and pursuit of those goals. Every client gets our undivided attention, from planning to execution to follow-up.

Includes
  • Retirement plans
  • Tax planning
  • 401(k) and 403(b) planning
02

Portfolio Management

We expect the unexpected, so you don’t have to.

Long-term asset management built around your risk tolerance, time horizon and goals, carefully balancing investment strategies with preserving principal.

Includes
  • Risk assessment
  • Asset allocation
  • Alternative investments
03

Retirement Income

You retire once. We retire people every day.

We understand the many challenges of retirement today and know the biggest concern for many is outliving their money. We focus on money management, as well as other issues that are critical to your financial well-being.

Includes
  • Traditional, Roth, SEP and SIMPLE IRAs
  • Deferred compensation plans
  • Profit sharing plans
04

Education Planning

Planning ahead for education costs.

Ways to save and pay for education, from education savings accounts to other college funding choices.

Includes
  • Education savings accounts
  • College funding choices
05

Estate Planning

Protecting what matters most.

Estate conservation and preserving wealth, including trust services and elder care planning.

Includes
  • Trust services
  • Elder care planning
  • Estate conservation
